preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the lab is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the lab is between n - 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of clones is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each edge is represented by two integers between 1 and n, inclusive.
preconditions.description: Each edge is represented by two integers that are the indices of the vertices it connects.
The graph is guaranteed to be a connected graph.

postconditions.expression: The output consists of k lines.
postconditions.description: Each line i contains the number of vertices visited by clone i followed by the indices of those vertices in the order they are visited.

postconditions.expression: Each clone visits at most <image> vertices.
postconditions.description: Each clone visits at most the number of vertices specified by the problem statement.

postconditions.expression: Each vertex is visited by at least one clone.
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the graph is visited by at least one clone.
It is guaranteed that a valid answer exists for the given input.
